title: Kissed Canadian Egg Tart
description: A tender, roasted egg tart with maple infused shortcrust pastry, topped with sautéed spinach and mushrooms, perfect for a date night.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C and line a baking sheet with parchment.
Heat a skillet over medium and sauté diced onion, minced garlic, and sliced mushrooms until softened, about 5 minutes, then add spinach and cook until wilted, seasoning with salt and pepper.
In a bowl whisk together eggs, heavy cream, maple syrup, and a pinch of salt.
Roll out the ready‑rolled shortcrust pastry to fit a 9‑inch tart pan and press into the bottom and up the sides, trimming excess dough.
Spoon the sautéed vegetables into the pastry shell and sprinkle the shredded cheddar evenly.
Pour the egg‑cream mixture over the vegetables, letting it seep into the gaps.
Bake for 20 minutes, then reduce the temperature to 180°C and bake an additional 10 minutes until the pastry is golden and the custard is set.
Remove from the oven, let rest 5 minutes, then cut into wedges and serve warm.
